description: This file defines a serializer class for handling GroupBusinessEvent objects, converting them to Avro data transfer objects using a mapper, and supporting schema identification.

classes.name: GroupsBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A Spring component that serializes GroupsBusinessEvent objects to Avro format, implementing the BusinessEventSerializer interface.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the provided BusinessEvent is an instance of GroupsBusinessEvent.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a BusinessEvent of type GroupsBusinessEvent into its corresponding Avro DTO using the mapper.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the schema class (CommandProcessingResultV1) supported by this serializer.
